[Trait] REBUILDING KNOWHERE At the beginning of the game, generate up to 4 standard objects into any squares within range.

[Trait] A LITTLE FUNNY MAN! FREE: If Drax is holding an object, put it down in an adjacent square. // Characters adjacent to an object Drax put down this turn modify damage +1 when making close attacks or when given a CLOSE Destroy action.
